name: Lavender oil
metabolism: This material contains multiple constituents and has no single ingredient-level metabolic pathway. Composition and constituent-specific metabolism must be distinguished; this entry does not yet provide a verified constituent-by-constituent account.
summary: Lavender oil is a complex essential-oil mixture distilled from lavender flower spikes. It is used in fragrance and aromatherapy; a standardized oral lavender-oil preparation is also used for anxiety disorders, though evidence for many lavender-oil uses is limited.
